# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.0.2

Version 1.0.2 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.0.1

- **Letters can be finished from the keyboard again.** After **Shift+Enter** (or Ctrl+Enter) the 「괜찮아?」 question
  came up, but then no key did anything, so the letter could not be finished. The game keeps the editor open
  under that question, and the keyboard kept typing into it. Now the keyboard is the controller again as soon as
  the editor stops taking input: **Enter** answers the question, the arrow keys choose 네/수정, and Left Shift is B.
  This also fixes the same problem in the address book.
- **Keys you are still holding are ignored until you let go of them.** So the Enter and Shift of Shift+Enter don't
  also answer the question (Left Shift is B, which would have answered "No").
- **Enter alone can finish a letter.** Enter still starts a new line. Where no line is left, it moves on to the
  closing (안드림), and Enter in the closing finishes the letter, as Start does. Other multi-line text (the message
  board, the notice board) finishes on Enter at its last line.
- **Android (system keyboard):** the on-screen keyboard hides while the 「괜찮아?」 question is up, and comes back
  if you go back to editing (수정).
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves and the Korean patch are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or v1.0.1**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch: Install). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Running, default keys and switching to Korean are described in the
  [v1.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.0.0) and the
  [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.2-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.2-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.2-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.2-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- With the Korean patch, using real key presses (on Linux, both the 32-bit build and this 64-bit release package):
  - Write a letter → Shift+Enter → 「괜찮아?」 → Enter → 네/수정 → Enter (네) → the letter is in the pocket, and
    Left Shift closes the menu.
  - Enter only: new lines up to the last line, then the closing, then 「괜찮아?」.
  - 수정 goes back to the letter; typing and the arrow keys work again.
  - Before the fix, the same keys left the question stuck.
- The scripted Korean letter test (write, finish with Enter in the closing, open it again, finish with Start, save)
  runs through.
- Windows 64/32-bit builds (Wine): new game → town with the scripted input, as in v1.0.1.
- The decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only; the matching build gives the same hashes.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.0.2, versionCode 10002). It was not
  run on a device.

## Known limitations

- The SD card, GBA link and Card e-Reader are treated as "no device".
- Not yet tested much on real Windows or Android devices.
- Villagers do not reply to letters with more than a few words of Korean (the same happens on a GameCube).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
